jobs.description:

We help every team bring brands to life — with governance in one place, seamless workflows across the tools people already use, and a foundation that's ready for AI.

We're driven by collaboration, curiosity, and the belief that great work can happen anywhere. What began in St. Gallen has grown to London, New York, and beyond. Wherever you join us, you'll take ownership from day one, shape work that reaches global brands, and help redefine how brands work in the age of AI.



Frontify is the brand platform behind some of the world's leading organizations, including Microsoft, Telefónica, Bosch, Mercedes-Benz, and Kia. We help every team bring brands to life — with governance in one place, seamless workflows across the tools people already use, and a foundation that's ready for AI.

We're driven by collaboration, curiosity, and the belief that great work can happen anywhere. What began in St. Gallen has grown to London, New York, and beyond. Wherever you join us, you'll take ownership from day one, shape work that reaches global brands, and help redefine how brands work in the age of AI.

 

End Closing Date: 1st October 2026

 

What you’ll shape

As a Professional Services Specialist, you’ll help deliver thoughtful and compelling POCs that show prospective customers how Frontify can work for their brand and organization.

Depending on the project, you might create the POC yourself or manage its delivery through one of our agency partners. You’ll turn customer requirements into clear briefs, coordinate timelines and progress, provide feedback, and make sure the final work meets our standards before it reaches the customer.

When creating POCs yourself, you’ll use customer brand guidelines, assets, and requirements to build Frontify environments that are visually strong, accurate, and relevant to what the customer is trying to achieve.

You’ll manage standard projects with growing independence, keeping stakeholders informed, identifying issues early, and asking for support when needed.

Tooling is an important part of how we work. You’ll use Frontify alongside creative, productivity, and AI-powered tools, experimenting with different approaches to help us work smarter, solve problems, and improve the quality of what we deliver.

We don’t expect you to arrive knowing everything. What matters most is that you’re curious, resourceful, organized, and excited to learn.




What you’ll do

 - Support the creation of Proofs of Concept (POCs) for prospective customers.

 - Help recreate and structure brand spaces based on existing brand guidelines, PDFs, or portals.

 - Create visually compelling brand showcases, presentations, and POC materials that support pre-sales conversations.

 - Ensure visual consistency, accuracy, and quality across POCs.

 - Review content and layouts to identify inconsistencies or missing elements.

 - Collaborate closely with the Professional Services team on shared POC initiatives.

 - Contribute to improving internal POC templates, guidelines, and best practices.

 

What you bring

 - You’re curious and enjoy learning new tools, technologies, and ways of working.

 - You’re comfortable experimenting with AI tools and interested in finding practical ways to use them in your day-to-day work.

 - You enjoy working with brands, visuals, layouts, and digital experiences, even if you don’t come from a traditional design background.

 - You’re comfortable coordinating work with others, setting clear expectations, following up on progress, and keeping projects moving.

 - You can take a customer request and turn it into a clear brief that someone else can successfully work from.

 - You have a strong eye for quality and are comfortable reviewing work, giving constructive feedback, and making sure the finished result meets expectations.

 - You’re resourceful. When you don’t know how to do something, you explore, test, ask questions, and find a way forward.

 - You’re organized and can manage multiple tasks, timelines, and priorities while knowing when to ask for support.

 - You communicate clearly and proactively with both internal stakeholders and external partners.

 - You enjoy collaborating with others and are open to feedback, different perspectives, and new approaches.

 - You’re interested in understanding the why behind a request, not just completing the task.

 - Experience with tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, Claude, ChatGPT or similar is helpful, but not required. We care more about your ability and willingness to learn.

 - You’re fluent in English; German is a plus.

 

What we offer

 - A minimum of 25 days annual leave per year

 - Paid educational and wellbeing days off

 - Stocked kitchen

 - Invite to our summer company meet-up

 



We understand that every candidate's experience is different. If you're interested in this role but don't tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

Frontify is a place where authenticity and inclusion thrive, empowering every voice to help shape our future. We're committed to providing a fair and accessible recruitment process. If you have a disability and require reasonable adjustments at any stage, please speak with your Talent Partner. Any information you share will remain confidential.

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Success
jobs.description:
Frontify is the brand platform behind some of the world's leading organizations, including Microsoft, Telefónica, Bosch, Mercedes-Benz, and Kia. What you'll shape

As Manager, Customer Success, you'll lead a team of Customer Success Managers responsible for driving retention, customer outcomes, and consistent execution across a growing book of enterprise customers.

You'll serve as the frontline leadership layer between the CSMs and the Director of Enterprise Customer Success EMEA, coaching performance, strengthening customer management discipline, and overseeing risk and escalation handling to keep the team focused on what matters most for customer health and retention.



What you'll do

Team leadership and people development

 - Lead, coach, and develop a team of  Customer Success Managers, setting a high bar for operating discipline across the team.

 - Drive performance management, including feedback, accountability, coaching plans, and development conversations.

 - Support hiring, onboarding, and ramping of new team members as the team evolves.

 - Identify growth opportunities for team members and shape a positive, adaptive culture built on accountability and diverse perspectives.

 - Run a predictable management cadence, including pipeline and renewal reviews, account reviews, forecasting discussions, and coaching touchpoints.

Customer retention, onboarding, and growth

 - Ensure the team is proactively managing customer relationships, renewal readiness, adoption risk, and long-term retention.

 - Oversee the customer onboarding experience, helping the team accelerate time-to-value so customers realize the benefits of the product quickly.

 - Ensure timely renewals and drive a multi-year renewal strategy as the default, optimizing commercial terms.

 - Guide CSMs through complex customer situations, including executive conversations, risk mitigation plans, and recovery strategies.

 - Maintain visibility into high-risk accounts, strategic renewals, and customer trends across the team.

Escalation management

 - Serve as the initial management layer for customer escalations.

 - Bring structure, urgency, and sound judgment to escalations, helping CSMs communicate clearly and confidently with customers.

Data-driven management

 - Maintain daily oversight of key metrics, including forecasting, pipeline, churn, contractions, expansion, forecast accuracy, and team capacity.

 - Conduct regular deep dives into KPIs to identify gaps in execution, coaching needs, and opportunities to improve team performance.

 - Partner with leadership to improve reporting, planning, and decision-making across the Customer Success organization.

Cross-functional partnership

 - Partner closely with enablement, sales, support, product, and other internal stakeholders to advocate for customer needs and unblock the team.

 - Contribute frontline insight on what is working, where customers are struggling, and what changes would improve outcomes at scale.



What you bring

 - You bring 3-4 years of people management experience in Customer Success, account management, or a related post-sale function in SaaS.

 - You are based in the St. Gallen area (or willing to relocate) and are comfortable coming into the office on average 2 days a week. 

 - You have a strong track record in performance management, coaching, and building accountability across a team.

 - You are comfortable leading through ambiguity, using metrics and operational data to keep teams focused on the highest-impact priorities.

 - You have experience managing customer risk, escalations, and complex stakeholder situations with strong judgment.

 - You are highly organized and know how to create structure, follow-through, and consistency across a team.

 - You have a strategic mindset that balances customer experience with revenue growth.

 - You are an excellent communicator who can build trust with customers, peers, and senior internal stakeholders.

 - You are comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, and team execution.

Nice to have

 - Experience leading distributed teams across multiple geographies or time zones.

jobs.description:

You'll ensure that Frontify's system infrastructure is cared for, maintained, and improved – it's a fast-changing infrastructure, so there's always something going on. Working closely with the R&D team, you'll investigate and identify the root cause of infrastructure issues, enabling the team to resolve them, as well as document relevant processes. Beyond managing the daily infrastructure needs, you'll be the first point of contact for our Europe- and US-based teams on anything related to the technical aspects of our platform.



What you'll do

 - Help develop and maintain a robust monitoring and observability framework to ensure system performance, reliability, and early issue detection.

 - Leverage your experience in DevOps to design, maintain, and improve cloud infrastructure.

 - Own and evolve incident management processes, including on-call, postmortems, SLOs, and error budgets.

 - Manage and optimize web servers, relational databases, and Linux-based systems.

 - Utilize expertise in Docker for containerization and manage orchestration tools such as Kubernetes or AWS ECS to ensure smooth deployment and scalability.

 - Work with AWS services to build and maintain scalable and secure cloud-based solutions.

 - Collaborate closely with other Engineering teams, QA and Security teams to streamline workflows, troubleshoot issues, and enhance system deployment processes.

 - Implement and maintain security best practices across infrastructure and deployments, including access management, vulnerability scanning, and incident response.

 - Contribute to ensuring compliance with security standards and help foster a strong DevSecOps culture within the engineering team.

 - Work remotely from anywhere in Switzerland or join us on-site in our St. Gallen office, with the flexibility to choose your best work environment.

 

What you bring

 - You have 5+ years of experience in a DevOps / Platform or Systems Engineer role – ideally in the SaaS space.

 - You’re comfortable with web servers (Nginx), relational databases (e.g., MySQL, including replication and performance tuning), and Linux (Amazon Linux/CentOS/RedHat).

 - You have knowledge and experience with Docker containerization, including container orchestration and management (e.g., Kubernetes or AWS ECS).

 - You have worked with AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Cloudfront or OpenSearch).

 - You’ve worked with Terraform in the past and can create infrastructure as code for scalable environments.

 - You have knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and have implemented automated build and deployment processes.

 - You have knowledge of Puppet configuration management (Bonus).

 - You’ve worked cross-functionally with Developer Support and Deployment Support roles.

 - You’re an IT generalist who’s comfortable shaping and defining the role with us.

 - You have a strong understanding of monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Datadog or Grafana).

 - You have experience applying SRE principles such as SLOs, and error budgets.

 - You have worked with incident management processes, including conducting postmortems and driving improvements.

 - You have a solid understanding of security practices in cloud and DevOps environments, including identity and access management (IAM), data protection, secrets management, and compliance considerations (e.g., ISO, GDPR).

 - You’re comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed team environment.

 - You speak English fluently.

jobs.description:

Your Mission

Our team owns Frontify’s media delivery path end-to-end, the engine that processes and serves every image and video, at ~180 TB of traffic a month. We build it and run it: from bulk asset transformation and fast preview generation to the Kubernetes infrastructure and CDN caching it all runs on. Our mission: media processing and delivery that absorbs any customer’s spike without ever slowing another customer, at a cost we’re proud of. You will play a significant role in making this a reality and in solving the technical challenges along the way.



Your Responsibilities

 - You'll build and enhance our media transformation engine — resizing, format conversion, and video processing — built on FFmpeg and native libraries, mostly through our Node.js services and occasionally in the C++ core.

 - You'll design and operate our services on Kubernetes (EKS): Helm charts, deployments, alerts. And simplifying what's grown too complex.

 - You'll work on our async bulk-processing capabilities: job queues, autoscaling for spiky workloads, and fairness between customers.

 - You'll help keep the delivery path fast and cheap, working with our caching and CDN layer (Varnish, HAProxy, CloudFront).

 - You'll participate in code reviews and write things down — designs, decisions, and runbooks — so the team's knowledge lives in documents, not in heads.



Your Story

 - You have experience designing, building, and maintaining high-quality, scalable backend and background processing services (Node.js, TypeScript, Go, or similar).

 - You have operated your own services in production on Kubernetes — Helm, monitoring, debugging live systems — not just deployed once and walked away.

 - You possess solid experience with AWS architecture and infrastructure, particularly regarding performance optimisation and cost management for S3, CloudFront, Lambda functions, and ALB at scale.

 - You're comfortable in Docker and Linux, and can read, compile and debug native code (C++) when the engine misbehaves, but you don't need to be a C++ expert.

 - Experience with media pipelines — FFmpeg, codecs, image or video processing — is a big plus; HDR and video expertise especially so.

 - Frontify's product is largely PHP; our path is mostly C++ and Node.js with a couple of PHP components. You don't need to be a PHP developer — but reading it and fixing the occasional bug shouldn't put you off.

 - You speak English fluently.
